summary: Model node:timers/promises setImmediate as a Promise fulfilled from Node's Immediate/check phase.

target.notes: Integrate with the Node-compatible timer scheduler and existing JsPromise/async-iteration semantics.

semantics.fulfillment: fulfills with value when the Immediate runs in the check phase
semantics.options: ref defaults true; signal may abort
semantics.promise_job: then/await continuation follows existing Promise microtask semantics

caveats: Do not substitute Task.Yield because it does not represent Node's check phase or ref state.

tests.name: fulfills supplied value
tests.expected_behavior: prints v after the Immediate becomes eligible
